title: Run input (canvas section 11)
description: What a person hands to the workflow orchestrator to start a run. Defaults are the AGENTS.md starting values; step_cap and token caps are optional here because AGENTS.md sets them but the input contract did not list them.

source_folder.description: The project folder to scan. Read-only for the whole run.

rules_file.description: Path to rules.json. Validated with rules.schema.json at the start of every run.

test_command.description: One command. Exit 0 is a pass, any other exit is a fail, no tests run means none.

confidence_gate.description: Applies only to findings found by the AI alone.

fix_when_cause_unclear.description: When the only objection is 'cause unclear' (no caller in the project), still prepare a local fix for a person to approve.
